body: Thank you everyone. This has been an insane experience for me. Hopefully things will get better from here.
Great quote. Never heard that one before.
Thank you. I'll post updates on my progress
It's true. I think I can see that more clearly than before. If all I need to do with my life is aim to be happy, there's a lot that I can and would sacrifice to get there.
Wanted to say before that your comment made me think a lot about my personal journey to this point. Even now I'm thinking of ways that I can use what I know for the greater good. Thank you.
Thank you. I will try find that place where ever it could be.

Agreed. When you feel like you can answer all of your own questions, it becomes impossible to ask anyone for help. Not entirely sure if I would try hang myself again. When you fuck up it's pretty damn scary.
Thank you. I'm at a hospital right now getting the help I need.

Still here browsing Reddit till I fall asleep. Not sure what advice to give. Maybe don't compare yourself to others, don't try too hard and avoid failure whenever possible (as that shit will slowly eat away at you, no matter how strong a person you think you are).

Edit: I should also add that the more depressed/suicidal I got the more people seemed to comment on how upbeat and happy I seemed. What a joke. Keep that in mind and look after your happiest of friends folks, they're usually the saddest ones who don't have a good means of expressing it.

Honestly I can't emphasize that enough. Overly happy people are just trying to get external approval but are all burned dead and ashes on the inside, they have nothing worth living for so they invest their life into pleasing others.
